## Summary

What changed, and why is this the smallest coherent change?

## Boundary affected

- [ ] simulator/runtime
- [ ] `SystemSpec` or mechanism contract
- [ ] optimizer, loss, validity, or evaluation

## Validation

List exact commands and results. Separate deterministic tests from model-backed
smoke runs or campaigns.

## Reproducibility and compatibility

- [ ] no raw outputs, caches, environments, model weights, or secrets committed
- [ ] schemas/protocols are versioned when their meaning changed
- [ ] frozen protocols and generated results were not silently rewritten
- [ ] new paths and Markdown links are valid
- [ ] resume, serialization, and provenance implications are documented

## Research impact

Does this require a new campaign revision, invalidate prior evidence, change a
loss or metric, or alter the simulator producer configuration? If not, say why.

## Known limitations

What remains unverified or intentionally out of scope?
